blocks.text: Thanks for testing 3.0. This build is focused on working well out in the yard, with or without a signal.
Offline inspections: start, fill in and save a full inspection with no connection. It syncs when you're back online.
Faster photo upload: photos upload in the background and resume if the connection drops.
Signed reports: inspectors can sign an inspection on the device, and the report shows who signed and when.

Offline sync conflict: if the same inspection is edited on two devices while offline, one set of edits can be overwritten. A fix is in progress. For now, please edit each inspection on one device only.
Crash on older Android devices: we've had crash reports from some older Android phones. We're investigating. If it happens to you, please send a report from Settings > Help.
Report bugs from Settings > Help in the app, or reply to the beta email. Go/no-go for the full release is Friday.
